steps.en: Install the framework via pipx and write it into Claude Code
steps.zh: 用 pipx 装好框架，再写入 Claude Code

steps.en: Drops 30 slash commands, 20 agent definitions and 7 behavioral modes into your Claude Code config
steps.zh: 把 30 命令、20 agent、7 模式写入 Claude Code 配置

steps.en: Restart Claude Code and invoke a command instead of pasting a prompt
steps.zh: 重启 Claude Code，用命令代替粘 prompt

steps.en: Injected behavioral instructions set the persona and mode, routing to the right domain agent
steps.zh: 行为指令注入设定 persona 与模式，路由到对应领域 agent

steps.en: Optionally wire MCP servers for live docs and web search
steps.zh: 可选地接上 MCP 服务，获得实时文档与搜索

steps.en: Powers /sc:research with multi-hop web search scored for source credibility
steps.zh: 让 /sc:research 做多跳网络调研，并按来源可信度打分

value.en: Claude Code starts every session with a shared command vocabulary and structured personas — no prompt-pasting discipline to maintain
value.zh: Claude Code 每次会话都自带共享命令词汇表和结构化 persona——不必再维护一套粘 prompt 的纪律
